# Streaming Hits Hollywood Hard: Here's Why with Producer Peter Hoffman

First listed: 2026-08-05 | Evaluation cutoff: 2026-11-10

[Back to library](../README.md)

## Source versions

- [Substack: Streaming Hits Hollywood Hard: Here's Why with Producer Peter Hoffman](https://realeismanplaybook.substack.com/p/streaming-hits-hollywood-hard-heres) - 2026-08-05

Earliest listed publication among matched versions, not proof of an unedited contemporaneous archive. Claim timestamps refer to the reviewed version.

## Summary

Eisman argues that streaming maturity and migration from legacy margins weaken entertainment investments, especially Disney and debt-heavy Paramount. Hoffman describes presale financing, production risk and changing independent-film economics, using his own films as examples. Netflix reported the cited EPS slowdown, but its next quarter rebounded sharply. Disney historical margins support a difficult transition without proving permanent stock stagnation. Hoffman prosecution narrative is kept separate from Eisman views and checked against court opinions that preserve the convictions while acknowledging disputes over actual and intended loss.

The quarterly earnings comparison is accurate, but extrapolating it into permanent streaming weakness requires more evidence. Historical margin differences are real but heterogeneous. Private production anecdotes and legal accusations remain distinct from established financial or judicial facts.
